Rescue uses Android's Accessibility service for one job: blocking what you chose to block.

What it reads
• The web address shown in browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Samsung Internet. If it can't find the address bar, it looks through the text on the browser screen for a web address.
• In Instagram and YouTube, how the screen is built (not your feed), to spot the full-screen Reels, Stories and Shorts players.
• Android only sends it events from browsers, Instagram and YouTube. It does not watch your other apps.
• Blocking apps you chose uses a separate permission, Usage access.

What it does
• Checks each address or screen on your phone against your block list.
• If there's a match, blocks that page or screen.
• If you turned on porn blocking, it also keeps your searches on safe search and blocks searches for banned words.

What stays private
• Rescue does not record or upload the pages you visit, what is on your screen, or which apps you use.
• Your block list, and your freeze and porn-blocking progress, are saved to your Rescue account so they survive a reinstall.
• You can turn Accessibility off any time in Android settings, but Rescue can't protect you without it.

MIUI can silently stop this app to save battery.

1. Battery saver → set to 'No restrictions'
2. Also open the Security app → Permissions → Autostart → turn it ON
One more thing for Oppo phones

ColorOS can silently stop this app to save battery.

1. Battery → App Battery Management → set to 'Allow background running'
2. Also enable Autostart for this app in App Management
One more thing for Vivo phones

FuntouchOS/OriginOS can silently stop this app to save battery.

1. Battery → Background power consumption management → allow this app
2. Also enable Autostart in i Manager → App manager
One more thing for OnePlus phones

OxygenOS can silently stop this app to save battery.

1. Battery → Battery optimization → find this app → Don't optimize
2. If shown, turn OFF 'Advanced optimization' for this app
One more thing for Samsung phones

One UI can put unused apps to sleep.

1. Settings → Apps → this app → Battery → set to 'Unrestricted'
2. Make sure it isn't listed under Device care → Battery → Sleeping apps
Your phone can stop this app in the background to save battery, which would silently turn protection off. Exempting it keeps protection running.
